subject: Re: OpalAI capacity — usage surge and next steps
messages:
From: Elliott Harper <elliott.harper@opalai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opalai.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden qps surge — can we talk expansion options?

Hey Karthik,

Quick heads-up: over the last 48 hours we've seen a sustained 3x jump in inference QPS on our prod route (chat-model-v2) — peak sustained tokens/sec up from ~18k to ~55k. It's mostly normal behavior (marketing campaign + new feature), but our p95 latency is creeping past the SLA and our engineering team is getting alerts on evictions.

Can Redwood provision dedicated capacity quickly or do we need a formal amendment? We're looking for a short-term buffer while we evaluate longer-term commit sizing. Ideally we'd like something that: 
- reduces p95 by ~30-50ms
- can be provisioned within 72 hours
- keeps traffic on dedicated nodes for data isolation reasons

I've attached the usage export for the last week (opal_usage_report.csv). Can we hop on a call to outline options + costs? Samira from infra is looped in.

Thanks,
Elliott
Director of Platform
OpalAI

Attachment: opal_usage_report.csv (csv)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elliott Harper <elliott.harper@opalai.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opalai.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden qps surge — can we talk expansion options?

Hi Elliott — thanks for the data, that helps a lot. I dug into the CSV and the pattern shows a clear increase in long-context generative sessions between 18:00–02:00 UTC. Two quick options we can stand up:

1) Short-term burst: provision an 8-GPU dedicated pool (A100 equivalent) for 21 days to absorb the spike. That typically drops p95 by ~35–60ms depending on request mix.

2) Commitment amendment: add a 6-GPU reserve to your Dedicated fleet with an autoscaling buffer for peak windows. We can structure a 6-9 month addendum with usage credits to soften unit price.

Operational notes: both options keep traffic on dedicated nodes. For the short-term burst we can provision within 48–72 hours once we confirm payment and networking (VPC peering) details. For the amendment we'd draft a proposed-amendment.pdf with pricing and mutual action plan.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick call today to confirm target (burst vs commit)
- If burst: provide billing PO and VPC details; we provision
- If commit: I loop in Vanessa for pricing & Naomi for procurement cadence; we prepare amendment and timeline

Would 3pm PT/6pm ET today work for a 30-min sync?

—Karthik
Head of Sales, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: Elliott Harper <elliott.harper@opalai.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@opalai.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden qps surge — can we talk expansion options?

Karthik / Naomi — fyi from commercial side. Elliott, thanks for the context. If Opal wants a fast buffer, we can do the 8-GPU burst for 21 days at a short-term uplift rate (details below) and convert any portion of that consumption into committed tranches within 90 days at a pro-rated credit.

High level pricing (preliminary):
- 21-day burst (8 x A100-equivalent): $32,000 one-time uplift billed upfront
- 6-month commit (6 GPUs): $28,000/month with 10% credit toward future usage if they convert within 90 days

Procurement notes: Naomi, can you confirm standard PO + invoicing terms for Opal? They usually need NET30 and an SOW reference. I'll prepare the proposed-amendment.pdf with both paths (burst->convert and direct commit).

Attachment: proposed-amendment.pdf (pdf)

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elliott Harper <elliott.harper@opalai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opalai.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden qps surge — can we talk expansion options?

Thanks Vanessa — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security and SRE teams: 
- We absolutely need traffic isolation on dedicated nodes; no routing to multi-tenant pools.
- For the burst window we may want automatic fallback rules to a 4-bit quantized variant of chat-model-v2 to preserve availability if queueing grows. Can Redwood support auto-fallback to a quantized variant?
- If we do the convert-to-commit path, can the 90-day conversion credit apply to both the compute commit and any reserved burst minutes?

Assuming those answers are yes, we prefer to start with the 21-day burst and evaluate conversion. Payment team can get a PO out by EOD tomorrow. Also, we have a handful of compliance questions I'll email separately (SOC2 artifacts + network logs retention).

On the call — can we lock a provisioning ETA and a tentative DocuSign link when you send the amendment?

—Elliott

On Wed, Sep 10, 2026 at 12:05 PM karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Elliott — thanks for the data, that helps a lot. I dug into the CSV and the pattern shows a clear increase in long-context generative sessions...
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elliott Harper <elliott.harper@opalai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Samira Khan <samira.khan@opalai.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden qps surge — can we talk expansion options? (Final)

Elliott / Samira — great to get this wrapped. Confirmations below: 
- Isolation: yes — traffic will remain on your dedicated nodes only. We'll set routing policy to prefer your fleet and block fallback to shared pools.
- Auto-fallback: we support an automatic fallback policy to your quantized variant (chat-model-v2-q4). We'll configure the policy to trigger when queue depth exceeds 85% for >45s and surface alerts to your SRE.
- Conversion credit: confirmed — any prepaid burst spend applied to compute commit (pro-rated) if you convert within 90 days. The proposed-amendment.pdf reflects the math.

Operational timeline: 
- 9/15 18:00 UTC: Redwood provisions 8-GPU burst pool and initiates VPC peering checks
- 9/16 00:00–04:00 UTC: smoke tests and gradual traffic cutover
- 9/16 08:00 UTC: monitoring handoff and escalation contacts confirmed

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/OPAL-3892/amendment (we'll send the envelope when payment/PO is received). Please route PO to billing@redwood.ai with reference OPAL-3892.

Attachments: amendment-signed.pdf (once complete)

I'll follow up after provisioning with measurable latency reductions and a usage dashboard link. Appreciate the quick coordination — we'll keep monitoring and stand ready to convert to a commit if usage stabilizes.

—Karthik
Head of Sales, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
